note: Every claim in the owning record maps to a named executed check with retained bytes, or is declared not_covered. A not_covered declaration does NOT silence this gate; it names the gap and still fails. Retained bytes must show the named check PASSING, so a mapping cannot be satisfied by a check that never ran.
retained_bytes_provenance: Gate bytes are produced by fresh detached processes in a dedicated detached worktree at the exact commit under review. A working-tree run is not admissible evidence here: a gate green in a working tree can be green on uncommitted bytes.
